findings.text: follow-on: the gate logs name their revision as `# rev: <sha>`, but the store's recorded_log_revision matcher accepts only the token `revision`, so the stored record's base_log_revision and head_log_revision read back as null even though each log's first line names the revision it ran at; the required added_failure_count (0) and added_failure_ids ([]) are derived correctly and are unaffected.

item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names the gate file, a scratch-copy fallback mutation kept with EXIT=, and baseline/after suites; baseline_suite.log (21 passed) and after_suite.log (22 passed) at revisions c51cf292f and f4dffef72 plus negative_control.log (1 failed, 1 passed, EXIT=1) supply each.
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is to pin the composer's refusal of an archive's own origin when none is stated; tests/standard_names/test_archive_reconstruction_entry_point.py:203 adds exactly that case over an extraction carrying origin catalog_edit, closing the coverage gap an earlier review identified at line 197.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records status complete, one commit f4dffef72, the gate at 22 passed, baseline 21 passed, and negative_control_log as a bare path whose header names module.__file__ and cwd.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the reviewed manifest declares tests/standard_names/test_archive_reconstruction_entry_point.py and docs/evidence/fragments/sn-integrity-backlog/sib-restore-archived-origin.html; both files in the diff are inside them and no product code changed.

justifications.durability: negative_control.log shows test_composition_requires_an_explicit_current_origin at tests/standard_names/test_archive_reconstruction_entry_point.py:197 stays green while the new case at :203 reddens under a composer that sources properties['origin'] when none is stated, so the added assertion is the unique guard for that regression.
justifications.evidence: baseline_suite.log (21 passed) and after_suite.log (22 passed) at revisions c51cf292f and f4dffef72 record the gate the done_when names, and negative_control.log (EXIT=1, 1 failed, 1 passed) shows the new case red under the fallback mutation.
justifications.fit: the new case follows the pytest.raises(..., match=...) idiom and docstring style of tests/standard_names/test_archive_reconstruction_entry_point.py:197 and introduces no name the repository naming rules forbid.
justifications.goal_fidelity: tests/standard_names/test_archive_reconstruction_entry_point.py:203 composes an extraction carrying origin catalog_edit with origin=None and requires refusal, which is the deliverable the goal names.
justifications.reuse: no production definition is added; the case extends the existing owner module and reuses the pre-existing _extraction(origin=...) parameter at tests/standard_names/test_archive_reconstruction_entry_point.py:41 rather than forking a second factory.
